subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a tributary of the Indus river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Son**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indus **is a **transboundary river **of **Asia **and a **trans-Himalayan river **of **South and Central Asia**.
 
• The **3,180 km **river **rises in Western Tibet**, flows **northwest through **the **disputed region of Kashmir, and bends**.
 
• The **origin of Indus river **is **Tibetan Plateau**, **Senge Zangbu**, **Gar River**.
 
• The **river touches Karachi, Peshawar, Gilgit, Attock, Thatta, Jamshoro, Rawalpindi, and Kot Mithan**.
 
• **Son **is not a **tributary of the Indus in India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Kabul River**, the **classical Cophen**, is **a 700-kilometer-long river **that emerges in **the Sanglakh Range **of the **Hindu Kush mountains **in the **northeastern part of Maidan Wardak Province, Afghanistan**. It is **separated **from the **watershed **of the **Helmand River **by the **Unai Pass**.
 
• **The Gilgit River **is **a tributary **of the **Indus River** and **flows through the Gupis-Yasin**, **Ghizer, **and **Gilgit districts **of **Gilgit-Baltistan**.
 
• The **Shyok River is **a **tributary **of the **Indus River **that **flows **through **northern Ladakh **and **enters Gilgit–Baltistan**, spanning some **550 km**. **The Shyok River originates **at the **Rimo Glacier**, one of the **tongues of the Siachen Glacier**.
